title: Failure handling policy
description: The dispatchable form of .agents/policies/failure.md: what kind of failure this is, and where it goes next. Read by Noetic.Harness.Conductor.

terminal_states.description: The five from the constitution. Keys are the outcomes a step may be recorded in.

observed.description: The row heading in failure.md. The validator asserts it is there.

match.description: A regex over the failure's evidence. Null where the class is detected from the run's shape rather than from text — `repeated_failure` is counted, not read.

route.description: capability:<id>, workflow:<id>, domain_owner, instrument, quarantine, report_unavailable.

stop.description: True where the policy says the work halts rather than continuing after the route.

classes.description: In priority order: the conductor takes the first class whose match fires, because evidence often reads as two at once and the order is the policy judgement about which to act on.
